message:
Add assembly.printedpart with named JSCAD face mounting (#4353)

* Add printed-part assemblies with named JSCAD face mounting

* Support existing CAD model sources for printed parts

* Use published printedpart props

* Use published jscad-planner reference support

* Use published headless jscad-fiber

* Emit assembly-specific source component ftypes
Use published GLTF rotation fix in assembly tests (#4355)

chore: update capacity autorouter to 0.0.958 (#4356)

Co-authored-by: Severin Ibarluzea <seve@tscircuit.com>

Support board-owned NEMA motor mounting alignment (#4347)

* Orient assembly motors using modelprinter wire and shaft-flat references

* Use compact NEMA geometry fixtures after smooth-screw optimization

* Resolve board-owned motor mounting alignment and layer orientation

* Use published assembly dependencies and fix post-merge checks

* Separate motor wire termination checks from mounting errors

* Pin NEMA test geometry and account for wires and rear fasteners
